[ELA 11/30, Learning Target] Look at illustrations in a story for clues about characters, settings, and mood.
[ELA 11/30, I Can] I can put myself in a character’s shoes and explain their perspective about the events in the story.
[ELA 11/30, Success Criteria] Describe what illustrations in Little Roja Riding Hood reveal about characters, settings, and mood.

[M 11/30, Lesson title] Lesson 16 - Add Areas
[M 11/30, Standard] 3.GSR.7.2 Determine the area of rectangles (or shapes composed of rectangles) presented in relevant problems by tiling and counting.
[M 12/7, Lesson title] Lesson 32 - Area and Perimeter of Shapes
[M 12/7, Standard] 3.GSR.8.1 Determine the perimeter of a polygon and explain that the perimeter represents the distance around a polygon. Solve problems involving perimeters of polygons.
[M 12/7, Standard] 3.GSR.8.2 Investigate and describe how rectangles with the same perimeter can have different areas or how rectangles with the same area can have different perimeters.
[M 12/14, Lesson title] Lesson 17 - Solve One-Step Word Problems Using Multiplication and Division
[M 12/14, Lesson title] Lesson 18 - Solve Two-Step Word Problems Using the Four Operations
[M 12/14, Standard] 3.PAR.3.6 Solve practical, relevant problems involving multiplication and division within 100 using part-whole strategies, visual representations, and/or concrete models.
[M 12/14, Standard] 3.PAR.3.7 Use multiplication and division to solve problems involving whole numbers to 100. Represent these problems using equations with a letter standing for the unknown quantity. Justify solutions.
